state.paragraph: the Board met in executive session (without Mr. Eder present) with representatives of GHF and discussed the status of the process, including that each potential buyer had been advised to submit a non-binding indication of interest by May 10, 2016 (which deadline was subsequently postponed to May 19, 2016 to ensure the potential buyers had sufficient time to formulate their most compelling offers).

ledger_rows.Note: Company (Noreck) approached these two separately to gauge interest; no response or outcome reported; they never entered the process.
Potential buyers advised to submit non-binding indications of interest by 05/10/2016; communicated before the 04/27 Board meeting.
IOI deadline postponed to 05/19/2016 to let buyers formulate compelling offers; revision itself undated, only bound is the new date.
IOI due date reached; nine IOIs followed; the Transaction Committee evaluated them on 05/23 and 06/01.
Excluded after IOI review as the lowest of the nine offers; decision made at the 05/23 and 06/01 Committee meetings.
Round 2 opened: Committee advanced seven after excluding two, opening management presentations and data-site diligence; LOIs later sought by 07/20.

deadline.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
